quarterly_data.signal: REC-4881 (FAP) efficacy, CFO Ben Taylor: Recursion was able to bring down the polyp burden (a combination of size and number of polyps) by 'a little over a 40% reduction' within 3 months, in patients who can have hundreds or even thousands of polyps. He put FAP at more than 50,000 patients in the U.S. and EU5, probably under-reported. Recursion is in discussions with the FDA on the pivotal trial design and will give an update on that later this year.
quarterly_data.figure: a little over a 40% reduction in polyp burden within 3 months; more than 50,000 patients (U.S. and EU5)
